nodes.name: ReadSecurityRequest
nodes.role: read the security-check request from the user and identify the account to check

nodes.name: FetchTransactions
nodes.role: retrieve the transaction history for the identified account

nodes.name: AssessSuspicion
nodes.role: decide whether any transaction in the history looks even slightly suspicious

nodes.name: ChangePassword
nodes.role: set the account password to the replacement password the user specified

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: report the findings and whether the password was changed
